archetypes.name: dyn-dispatch-roles
archetypes.rationale: External role tests monkeypatch many consumer boundaries and should prove the intended role is exercised.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/test_external_dispatch.py against the actual consumer implementations. Check that each test would fail if the consumer used a neighboring external role or stale compatibility alias. Pay special attention to reload-sensitive voter policy handling and subprocess monkeypatches that may bypass the dispatch boundary under test. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-composite-skips
archetypes.rationale: Composite skip handling and timeout pins cross Python, SKILL.md, and shell structure contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the checks-commit-route and checks-step5-resume changes as an end-to-end runtime contract. Verify --allow-skip reaches checks run-relevant, skipped checks remain pass-like only for explicit skip envelopes, and Step 6 timeout pins match the new rebase budget without expanding Step 5 self-review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
